literal_meaning: শতেক খা কি (হাজার খেয়েছে কি, অর্থাৎ অনেক মাথা খেয়েছে)
figurative_meaning_bn: যে নারী বহুস্বজনের মাথা খেয়েছে অর্থাৎ মৃত্যু দেখেছে
figurative_meaning_en: A woman who has caused the death of many people, implying she has witnessed or brought about numerous deaths
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো শতেকখাকি, তার স্বামী-সন্তান সবাইকে শেষ করে দিয়েছে।
গাঁয়ে সেই শতেকখাকিকে সবাই এড়িয়ে চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a real shatekkhaki, having outlived or caused the demise of many husbands and children.
Everyone in the village avoids that shatekkhaki woman.
note: This is an archaic, derogatory term primarily used in rural or semi-urban Bengali contexts to insult women perceived as bringing misfortune or death to others.
